exercises.instruction: Choose the tense that best fits the context.
exercises.explanation: Spontaneous decision made at the moment of speaking → will + V1.

exercises.prompt: By the time the guests arrive, we ___ all the food.
exercises.hint: 'By the time' + completion before a future event → future perfect.
exercises.explanation: Action completed before a future point → will have + V3.

exercises.instruction: Which tense shows an action in progress at a specific future moment?
exercises.prompt: This time next month, she ___ her finals.
exercises.hint: 'This time next month' = a future moment → action in progress at that point → future continuous.
exercises.explanation: Action in progress at a specific future moment → will be + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Plan already decided — which form is correct?
exercises.prompt: I ___ quit my job and travel the world — I've already handed in my notice.
exercises.hint: Proof of a pre-decided plan (handed in notice already) → going to.
exercises.explanation: Pre-decided plan with evidence → am/is/are going to + V1.

exercises.instruction: Choose the tense that shows duration reaching a future milestone.
exercises.prompt: By next June, she ___ at the hospital for three years.
exercises.hint: 'By next June' + 'for three years' + duration emphasis → future perfect continuous.
exercises.explanation: Duration of ongoing activity reaching a future deadline → will have been + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Visible evidence now — prediction about the future.
exercises.prompt: Look at the forecast — it ___ all weekend.
exercises.hint: Visible evidence (forecast) → going to for prediction.
exercises.explanation: Prediction based on current evidence → is/are going to.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct negative future form.
exercises.prompt: She ___ the meeting by 5pm — the discussion is running long.
exercises.hint: 'By 5pm' + not completing before that deadline → future perfect negative.
exercises.explanation: Not completed before a future deadline → won't have + V3.

exercises.prompt: ___ you ___ the projector for the whole afternoon?
exercises.hint: Polite inquiry about existing plans → future continuous.
exercises.explanation: 'Will you be using?' = polite future continuous inquiry. Softer than 'Will you use?'

exercises.instruction: Stative verb + future — which form is correct?
exercises.prompt: By their 20th anniversary, they ___ each other for over 25 years.
exercises.hint: 'Know' is stative. Duration to a future point + stative = future perfect simple.
exercises.explanation: Stative verb 'know' cannot use continuous. Duration to future point → will have known.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct future tense.
exercises.prompt: By the time the conference starts, I ___ (rehearse) my speech for over a week.
exercises.hint: 'By the time' + 'for over a week' + duration emphasis → future perfect continuous.
exercises.explanation: Duration of ongoing activity up to a future point → will have been + Ving.

exercises.prompt: Don't call at 3pm — she ___ (meet) a client at that time.
exercises.hint: 'At that time' = a specific future moment → action in progress → future continuous.
exercises.explanation: Action in progress at a specific future time → will be + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Translate — decide which future tense each clause needs.
exercises.prompt: Besok pagi, saya akan pergi ke dokter. Saya sudah membuat janji temu.
exercises.modelAnswer: Tomorrow morning, I am going to go to the doctor. I have already made an appointment.
alternativeAnswers: Tomorrow morning, I'm going to go to the doctor. I've already made an appointment.
Tomorrow morning, I am going to see the doctor. I have already made an appointment.
I am going to go to the doctor tomorrow morning. I have already made an appointment.
exercises.hint: Appointment already made = pre-decided plan → going to.
exercises.explanation: Evidence of pre-decided plan → going to + V1.

exercises.instruction: Translate. Action in progress at a future moment.
exercises.prompt: Pada tengah malam nanti, pesawat mereka sedang terbang di atas Samudra Pasifik.
exercises.modelAnswer: At midnight tonight, their plane will be flying over the Pacific Ocean.
alternativeAnswers: At midnight, their plane will be flying over the Pacific.
exercises.hint: 'Sedang terbang' at a future time = will be flying.
exercises.explanation: Action in progress at a specific future moment → will be + Ving.

exercises.instruction: Translate — completion before a future deadline.
exercises.prompt: Sebelum akhir semester, dia sudah menyelesaikan semua tesisnya.
exercises.modelAnswer: Before the end of the semester, she will have completed her entire thesis.
alternativeAnswers: Before the end of the semester, he will have completed his entire thesis.
She will have finished her thesis before the end of the semester.
By the end of the semester, she will have completed her entire thesis.
exercises.hint: 'Sudah menyelesaikan sebelum' = will have completed before → future perfect.
exercises.explanation: Completion before a future deadline → will have + V3.

exercises.instruction: Translate — duration reaching a future milestone.
exercises.prompt: Pada ulang tahun perusahaan ke-10, kami sudah melayani pelanggan selama satu dekade.
exercises.modelAnswer: By the company's 10th anniversary, we will have been serving customers for a decade.
alternativeAnswers: By the company's tenth anniversary, we will have been serving customers for a decade.
By our 10th anniversary, we will have been serving customers for ten years.
exercises.hint: 'Sudah melayani selama satu dekade' at a future point = will have been serving for a decade.
exercises.explanation: Duration of ongoing activity to a future milestone → will have been + Ving.
